title: Services
text: RafikiArdhi works with research groups, government agencies, development programmes, NGOs and engineering teams. Each engagement starts with a short written scope: what will be delivered, by when, and on what terms.

title: Services
text:
Soil and landscape mapping

Digital soil mapping of soil properties by depth, with uncertainty
Updating existing regional maps with new survey data
Soil functional and fertility domains for planning
Soil sampling design for mapping and monitoring

title: Services
text:
Hydrology and runoff parameters

Hydrologic soil group (HSG) mapping from geology and terrain, as class probabilities
Curve number and potential maximum retention surfaces with uncertainty, ready for hydrological models
Soil-water flux modelling along slopes and catenas

title: Services
text:
Geostatistics and data analysis

Variogram analysis, kriging and regression kriging
Mixed models for nested and repeated soil data
Cross-validation and model checking
Analysis of existing datasets, including troubleshooting problem data

title: Services
text:
Decision support

Combining several sources of uncertainty into a single, readable decision map
Prioritisation of areas for management, restoration or further sampling
Plain-language summaries for non-specialist decision makers

title: Services
text:
Review and training

Independent technical review of reports, models and maps
Short courses and workshops in digital soil mapping and geostatistics in R


The scientific work is provided as environmental science and analysis. Where a project requires a licensed professional engineer, RafikiArdhi works alongside the engineering team.

title: Evidence for decisions about land, soil and water

Environmental analytics


RafikiArdhi turns field data, remote sensing and terrain into maps, models and uncertainty estimates that land managers, researchers and development programmes can act on.
Get in touch

title: Evidence for decisions about land, soil and water
text:
What we do


Soil and landscape mapping
Depth-consistent digital soil maps, soil property surfaces and functional domains, from plot to national scale.


Hydrology and runoff
Hydrologic soil groups, curve numbers and runoff parameters, and soil-water flux modelling across hillslopes.


Geostatistics and uncertainty
Variograms, kriging, mixed models and uncertainty propagation, so every map comes with an honest error estimate.


Decision support
Turning model output and its uncertainty into clear, policy-ready classes and priorities.

Where we work
Southern, East and Central Africa · the Caribbean · the western United States. Work is delivered remotely, personally on site or with local partners in the field.

title: About
text:
Founder and principal scientist
Trevan Flynn holds a PhD in soil science, with a focus on quantitative pedology. His work aims to improve our understanding of multidimensional soil resilience and soil multifunctionality, and to advance soil knowledge and decision-support systems in resource-poor regions.
He has lived and worked across Southern, Centeral and Eastern Africa, from national-scale soil mapping to extension work with smallholder farmers on heavily leached soil.
His research has been funded through the South African National Research Foundation, The Southern African Science Service Centre for Climate Change and Adaptive Land Management (SASSCAL), EU Horizon 2020, EU LIFE and the Australian Research Council, and he has assembled international consortia for World Bank and BRICS proposals. He has taught crop and soil science at university level and introduced a course in digital soil mapping and remote sensing in agriculture at Stellenbosch University.
He publishes with a global network of collaborators in journals including Geoderma, Science of the Total Environment, Catena, Pedosphere, and Journal of Environmental Management.

The name
Rafiki ardhi short for “friend of the land”.

title: About
text:
Approach
We build on existing knowledge rather than replacing it. Every map is updated, not reset; every estimate carries its uncertainty; and every result is explained in terms the decision maker can use.
